summary: Comprehensive testing of Leave-Attendance-Payroll integration flow completed. All 20 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified My Leaves page with leave application dialog and Payroll page with incentive input fields. Key features tested: employee leave application, manager approval/rejection, HR applying leave on behalf, payroll inputs with incentives, salary slip generation, attendance summary, and leave balance calculation.

issues: Route is /my-leaves not /my/leaves - consistent with other routes but navigation sidebar link may be using different path

critical_code_review_comments: Leave request creation working via POST /api/leave-requests with proper validation
Manager approval/rejection via POST /api/leave-requests/{id}/rm-approve functioning correctly
HR can apply leave on behalf via POST /api/attendance/hr/apply-leave-for-employee (auto-approved)
Payroll inputs with incentive field working via POST /api/payroll/inputs
Salary slip generation includes incentives in earnings (test verified Rs.15,000 incentive added)
Attendance records integration with payroll linkage-summary endpoint working
seed_data_creation: Test created leave requests, payroll inputs with incentives (Rs.15,000 for test employee). Existing test data used: 8 leave requests with various statuses, 4 employees with payroll inputs containing incentives (5000, 7500, 10000, 12500).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Leave-Attendance-Payroll integration fully tested. Test credentials: Admin=EMP001/admin123, HR=EMP002/admin123, Consultant=CON001/consultant123. All APIs working. Frontend route for My Leaves is /my-leaves not /my/leaves.

leave_management: Employee can apply for leave via POST /api/leave-requests (with leave type, dates, reason, half-day option)
HR can view pending leave requests via GET /api/leave-requests?status=pending
HR can view all leave requests via GET /api/leave-requests/all
Manager can approve leave via POST /api/leave-requests/{id}/rm-approve with action=approve
Manager can reject leave via POST /api/leave-requests/{id}/rm-approve with action=reject
HR can apply leave on behalf via POST /api/attendance/hr/apply-leave-for-employee (auto-approved)
Employee can withdraw pending leave via POST /api/leave-requests/{id}/withdraw
Leave balance calculation working via GET /api/leave-requests/employee/{id}/balance
My leave balance endpoint working via GET /api/my/leave-balance
Company-wide leave stats available via GET /api/leave-requests/stats/company-wide
payroll_management: Get payroll inputs for month via GET /api/payroll/inputs?month=YYYY-MM
Save payroll input with incentive via POST /api/payroll/inputs (includes incentive, incentive_reason fields)
Generate salary slip via POST /api/payroll/generate-slip (includes incentives in earnings)
Payroll linkage summary via GET /api/payroll/linkage-summary?month=YYYY-MM (shows pending reimbursements, LOP leaves, salary slips)
frontend_ui: My Leaves page loads with Apply Leave button (data-testid='apply-leave-btn')
Leave balance cards showing Casual, Sick, Earned leave balances
Apply Leave dialog with all required form elements (leave-type, leave-start, half-day-checkbox, leave-reason, submit-leave)
Leave requests table showing type, from/to dates, days, reason, status, action columns
Withdraw button available for pending leaves
Payroll page loads with tabs (Salary Slips, Payroll Inputs, Components, Approval, Bulk Upload, Data Health)
Payroll Inputs tab shows employee table with incentive column (Incent) - values visible: 5000, 10000, 12500, 15000
